pages.text: The pack ships graphics profiles by $(bold)hardware$(), applied by the launcher from the PEACOCK_PROFILE setting in Prism:$(br2)$(bold)potato$() iGPU, shaders off$(br)$(bold)low$() iGPU, Complementary at Potato$(br)$(bold)medium$() thin laptops, a MacBook Air$(br)$(bold)high$() laptop with a real GPU$(br)$(bold)ultra$() desktop

Anything you change in the video or shader menus is kept; the profile only sets defaults. Shaders toggle with $(bold)K$(). If frames drop: lower Distant Horizons' radius first, shaders second, render distance last.$(br2)Macs stay on plain Complementary; the Euphoria variant exceeds what macOS OpenGL offers.

$(bold)Distant Horizons$() draws the far terrain from a low-detail copy the server builds as players explore. On a fresh world the horizon fills in over the first hour; a reset world starts over.$(br2)Embeddium, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, ModernFix and FerriteCore are the quiet half of the frame rate; leave them on.

$(bold)Resource packs$() ship with the pack and are on by default: Fresh Animations (vanilla mobs and villagers move like living things), Better Leaves, Enhanced Boss Bars, xali's enchanted books and potions, Low on Fire.$(br2)All optional: Options, Resource Packs. Fresh Animations is the only one that costs anything, and only in a crowd.
